# EST plugin: an EST effect in C++ (CLAP)

> An EST plugin is a CLAP 1.2 plugin compiled to WebAssembly (wasm32, no imports), packed with its manifest into a `.est` bundle that a host such as Cyber validates, meters and runs in a sandbox. Start with AGENTS.md in this folder. Every link below is a file in this folder (made by `est new`) or a page of the kit's documentation (`sdk/docs/` in the Cyber clone the kit runs from: `<cyber>/sdk/docs/…`).

## This plugin

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the layout, the commands, the toolchain, the allocation and determinism rules, the identity and state rules, the rule ids, and the loop: build, `est validate`, read dist/validation.json, fix
- [est.json](est.json): the manifest (its `$schema` is the schema below); the only file that names the plugin
- [src/gain.hpp](src/gain.hpp): the DSP, plain C++
- [src/plugin.cpp](src/plugin.cpp): the CLAP side (entry, factory, descriptor, parameters, state, ports)
- [est-build.json](est-build.json): the build (sources, include folders, defines, standard)
- [test/golden.json](test/golden.json): the golden render's spec (its events name parameters by id)

## The contract, machine-readable (in this folder)

- [est-manifest-1.schema.json](est-manifest-1.schema.json): the manifest's JSON Schema (2020-12)
- [est-validator-rules.json](est-validator-rules.json): every validator rule: its id (EST-M, -B, -W, -C, -U, -P), title, explanation, fix and severity
- [est-abi-1.0.json](est-abi-1.0.json): the ABI: every CLAP struct's size and offsets on wasm32 and every constant
- [est-ui.d.ts](est-ui.d.ts): the types of the UI library (`window.EstUI`), for a custom UI

## The kit

- sdk/cpp/include/est/runtime.hpp: the freestanding runtime (memset, memcpy, malloc, free, new, delete, the maths)
- sdk/cpp/include/clap/: the CLAP 1.2.2 headers
- sdk/docs/porting-cpp.md: porting a C++ plugin: the toolchain, what breaks and EST's replacements, `est compare`
- sdk/docs/porting-juce.md: a JUCE plugin: one source tree, the desktop build and the EST module
- sdk/docs/porting-clap.md: what EST adds to CLAP and what it refuses
- sdk/docs/concepts.md, sdk/docs/getting-started.md, sdk/docs/dev-host.md, sdk/docs/for-agents.md
- sdk/docs/manifest.md and sdk/docs/validator-rules.md: the same as the two JSON files above, as pages

## Optional

- `<cyber>/docs/est/EST_SPECIFICATION_DRAFT.md`: the EST specification: background, not needed to write a plugin
